year_shape.name: year_shape
year_shape.value: ("children"."expecting" and "children"."birth_year" is null and "children"."due_year" is not null) or (not "children"."expecting" and "children"."birth_year" is not null)

allowance_shape.name: allowance_shape
allowance_shape.value: ("people"."allowance_mode" = 'as_relevant' and "people"."monthly_contact_allowance" is null) or ("people"."allowance_mode" = 'fixed' and "people"."monthly_contact_allowance" in (1,3,5))

verified_if_named.name: verified_if_named
verified_if_named.value: "people"."phone" is null or "people"."phone_verified_at" is not null

price_shape.name: price_shape
price_shape.value: "place_contributions"."price_band" is null or "place_contributions"."price_band" in ('free','prefer_not_to_say') or "place_contributions"."price_unit" is not null
